metaDescription: Nargis, born 1 June 1929 in Kolkata. Married to Sunil Dutt. Full biography, family, career and awards.
lead: Nargis was a film actor, born on 1 June 1929 in Kolkata.
She died on 3 May 1981 in Mumbai at the age of 51.
She is associated with work such as Barsaat, Babul and Awaara and has held the office of member of Rajya Sabha.
Below you will find a verified overview of Nargis: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Nargis — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Nargis was born on 1 June 1929 in Kolkata, and holds citizenship of British Raj and India. She was given the name Fatima Rashid at birth and is publicly known as Nargis.
Public records name her mother, Jaddanbai.
Her listed education includes Queen Mary School, Mumbai.

sections.heading: Nargis — Career and Professional Work
paras: Her professional record lists film actor, screenwriter and politician as her occupations.
Among the credits most often linked to Nargis are Barsaat, Babul, Awaara, Shree 420, Mother India and Raat Aur Din.
She has held the following offices: member of Rajya Sabha (1980–1981).
